items.evidence: p20.transfer(2, plasmid_plate['A1'], cells, ...) moves 2 uL from plate A1 to tube A1 with the p20.
The comment records 42°C for 45 s, then ice for 2 min, and it comes after the DNA transfer.
p300.transfer(250, soc_reservoir['A1'], cells) comes after the heat-shock comment, and the 37°C, 60 min, 250 rpm comment follows it.
new_tip='always' on each single-destination transfer gives one fresh tip for the DNA and one for the SOC. The no_cross_contamination and tip_dropped_at_end checks passed.
mix_after=(3, 10) was added to the DNA transfer. The task does not ask for it, and pipette-mixing competent cells could change the transformation outcome.

judge.summary: The protocol does the DNA addition, heat-shock and SOC steps in order, uses fresh tips, and passes all measured checks. It fails fidelity because it adds an unrequested 3x mix of the competent cells after the DNA transfer.
